tools.name: navixy_get_workspace
tools.description: Show the workspace that the API key reaches: its id, title, whether it is active, and its organization id. Good first call to confirm the connection. Navixy GraphQL: bdr.workspace.

tools.name: navixy_list_assets
tools.description: List the assets (vehicles, equipment and other tracked objects) in the workspace, with their type and primary device. Filter by title or asset type. Navixy GraphQL: bdr.assets.

tools.name: navixy_get_asset
tools.description: Get one asset by id: its type, its primary device with status, and the asset groups it belongs to. Navixy GraphQL: bdr.asset.

tools.name: navixy_list_devices
tools.description: List the GPS trackers and sensors in the workspace, with their status, model, vendor and the asset they are linked to. Filter by title, identifier (such as an IMEI) or status. Navixy GraphQL: bdr.devices.

tools.name: navixy_get_device
tools.description: Get one device by id: its status, model, vendor, type, identifiers (such as IMEI) and the asset it is linked to. Navixy GraphQL: bdr.device.

tools.name: navixy_list_asset_groups
tools.description: List the asset groups of the workspace (typed, colour-coded collections of assets for fleet segmentation). Filter by title. Navixy GraphQL: bdr.assetGroups.

tools.name: navixy_list_geo_objects
tools.description: List the geofences, points of interest and routes of the workspace, with their type. The geometry is not returned. Navixy GraphQL: bdr.geoObjects.

tools.name: navixy_list_asset_states
tools.description: List the live state of assets: last position, speed, motion (moving, stopped, parked), connectivity (online, offline, never reported) and recent readings of the primary device. Use the filters to find, for example, all offline vehicles. Navixy GraphQL: tracking.assetStates.

tools.name: navixy_get_asset_state
tools.description: Get the live state of one asset: position, speed, motion, connectivity, readings and recent events of every linked device. Navixy GraphQL: tracking.assetState.

tools.name: navixy_get_device_state
tools.description: Get the live state of one device (GPS tracker or sensor): position, speed, motion, connectivity, readings and recent events. Navixy GraphQL: tracking.deviceState.

tools.name: navixy_get_asset_timeline
tools.description: Get the trips (tracks) and stops of an asset in a time range, with distance, driving time, stop time and the start and end points. Route points are not returned. The range is limited by the vendor. Navixy GraphQL: tracking.assetTimeline.
